objective: Define local/static authority-state response policy and applyVerifiedAuthorityGate compatibility expectations before /ask conversational runtime formatting changes.
description: Offline compatibility fixture for short /ask answers, authority-state discipline, source limitation wording, exact-vs-related authority handling, NO_INDEXED_SOURCE non-fabrication, generic guards, and applyVerifiedAuthorityGate representative inputs.

cases.name: Short /ask AUTHORITY_FOUND answer with verified RR 2-98
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Verified citation-bearing lines may remain when RR 2-98 is present in final source cards.
forbiddenPhrases: A governing authority was not directly located
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: No related-only or no-indexed-source limitation is required when an exact indexed authority supports the short answer.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: RR 2-98 may be described as governing only within the scope of the exact indexed source.
cases.noIndexedSourcePolicy: Not applicable; exact authority is present.
cases.genericGuardPolicy: Not a generic guard case because the query names a specific authority.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Exact RR 2-98 source card may be described as governing if verified.
cases.risk: Short answers can overclaim beyond the source if the gate allow-list is incomplete.
cases.notes: Representative applyVerifiedAuthorityGate compatibility case for AUTHORITY_FOUND.

cases.name: Short /ask RELATED_AUTHORITY_ONLY answer preserves caution
cases.query: /ask Any authority or revenue regulation about NOLCO?
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Controlling/Governing/Primary authority headings must be relabeled as Related / Supporting Authorities.
requiredPhrases: A governing authority was not directly located
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must preserve source limitation wording or at least equally cautious wording.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: Clickable related source must not be described as exact or governing.
cases.noIndexedSourcePolicy: Not applicable; related source exists but is not exact.
cases.genericGuardPolicy: Not a generic guard case because the query asks for NOLCO authority.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Related/supporting source cards must remain labeled as related/supporting only.
cases.risk: Conversational prose may turn related source into a governing conclusion.
cases.notes: Representative applyVerifiedAuthorityGate relabel case for short /ask.

cases.name: Short /ask NO_INDEXED_SOURCE answer blocks fabricated BIR Ruling support
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Citation-bearing lines must be suppressed under NO_INDEXED_SOURCE; clean limitation-only answers pass through.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must disclose that no indexed source was located for direct verification.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: No related G.R./NIRC substitute may be treated as the exact BIR Ruling authority.
cases.noIndexedSourcePolicy: No fabrication; no invented indexed source; general orientation only if safe.
cases.genericGuardPolicy: Not generic; this is a specific but unavailable authority.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: No source card should be shown or implied for the unavailable BIR Ruling.
cases.risk: Short answers may be tempted to fill missing source with unrelated authority.

cases.name: Short /ask GENERAL_TAX answer does not promote generic withholding tax
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Gate cannot replace generic-query classification; fixture policy requires no exact authority promotion.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: General explanation may proceed without exact source-card claims.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: No exact-vs-related source claim should be made for generic wording.
cases.noIndexedSourcePolicy: Not a no-source claim; this is a generic explanation state.
cases.genericGuardPolicy: Generic query is non-promotable and may ask for narrower facts or authority.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: No fabricated source card or exact authority card required.
cases.risk: General tax explanation can be over-promoted into a specific RR or NIRC answer.

cases.name: /tax senior memo AUTHORITY_FOUND keeps verified NIRC Sec. 57
cases.expectedGatePolicy: A-F memo citations may remain when every citation-bearing line is verified.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: No no-source limitation required when exact NIRC authority is verified.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: Exact NIRC Sec. 57 may be framed as governing within its scope.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Exact source card may be governing; unsupported extra citations must still be suppressed.
cases.risk: Formal memo structure can hide unverified extra citations.
cases.notes: Professional structure remains compatible with gate allow-list behavior.

cases.name: /tax senior memo RELATED_AUTHORITY_ONLY relabels controlling headings
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Controlling/Governing authority headings must not survive under RELATED_AUTHORITY_ONLY.
requiredPhrases: A governing authority was not directly located
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Memo must preserve limitation wording and cautious conclusion.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: Related PEZA/VAT sources cannot be described as controlling.
cases.risk: A-F memo headings may imply certainty even when authority is related-only.
cases.notes: Protects /tax structure before later runtime formatting.

cases.name: /audit RELATED_AUTHORITY_ONLY advisory preserves caution
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Audit advisory may discuss related authority but cannot present it as exact governing authority.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must preserve related-authority limitation when exact LOA authority is absent.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: Related procedural source cards are supporting only.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Related source cards must not visually validate unsupported audit conclusions.
cases.risk: Audit tone can overstate a defense when sources are only related.

cases.name: /audit NO_INDEXED_SOURCE advisory blocks invented procedure
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Citation-bearing procedural claims must be suppressed when no indexed source exists.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must disclose source unavailability before procedural recommendations.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: No exact or related card should be treated as governing.
cases.noIndexedSourcePolicy: No fabrication; recommend document review/current authority check only.
cases.genericGuardPolicy: Not generic; audit/procedure issue with no indexed source.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: No source card should be fabricated.
cases.risk: Audit users may rely on invented procedural deadlines.

cases.name: Generic query tax law remains non-promotable
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Gate is not a generic classifier; response policy must prevent exact authority promotion before generation.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: No exact-source claim for a generic term.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: No exact/related source distinction should be invented.
cases.noIndexedSourcePolicy: Not no-indexed-source; it is too broad/generic.
cases.genericGuardPolicy: Non-promotable generic wording: tax law, BIR issuance, court case, VAT case, withholding tax case, explain EWT, what is withholding tax.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not attach fabricated named authority or exact source card.
cases.risk: Single generic phrase can be over-mapped to available authority.
cases.notes: Generic guard control covering the required generic family.

cases.name: Exact source limitation preservation for Seagate
cases.query: /ask Expound CIR v. Seagate Technology G.R. No. 153866.
cases.expectedGatePolicy: Exact authority answers must not include false related-only or no-indexed-source limitation wording.
forbiddenPhrases: A governing authority was not directly located
No indexed source was located for direct verification
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Suppress false no-direct-authority limitation when exact source is present.
cases.exactVsRelatedPolicy: Exact source card differs from related/supporting cards and may be described as governing only if verified.
cases.genericGuardPolicy: Not generic; named case and docket supplied.
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Exact source card should not carry related/supporting suffix.
cases.risk: Conversational shortening could add generic source limitation even when exact authority exists.
cases.notes: Bridges PATCH-06F-005 exact-source limitation discipline into Phase 7A.
